evidence: TEST-198: Generate and Verify passed with Memory excluded; Finalize initially failed on unconditional memory validation.
TEST-204: Same selective-generation failure pattern; passed after the correction.
TEST-210: Same selective-generation failure pattern; passed after the correction.

plannedProjectAdoption.lesson: Lifecycle preconditions must be derived from the explicitly selected product set. Optional products must not introduce mandatory lifecycle requirements when they were intentionally excluded.
plannedProjectAdoption.title: Selected products define lifecycle preconditions
